assets.name: story-stay-v3
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE finished transparent 3D narrative illustration for Zainlak mobile onboarding. Create a compelling coherent miniature scene, NOT a giant icon with tiny accessories. Sophisticated soft cartoon 3D characters with expressive faces, adult proportions gently stylized, rounded sculptural forms, satin clay/porcelain, beautifully soft studio lighting, gentle dimensional highlights, refined commercial animation quality. Color family: rich teal #0aa38a, emerald shaded sides, orange/orangered #f47935 accents, warm ivory, warm skin tones, small lavender and sky-blue accents; varied attractive colors. Consistent slightly elevated frontal three-quarter camera, square canvas. The entire scene including all characters' feet, architecture tops, foliage, airplane wings, bags must fit in the central 82% with transparent empty margin on EVERY side. Fully modeled rounded object silhouettes, not a rectangular crop of a landscape. Architecture is freestanding and complete, with no cut walls or abrupt scene edges. No enclosing disc, square platform, border, flat colored background, words, typography, watermark, fake UI text, logos, halos or rings baked into the image. Genuine transparent alpha background. Small natural contact shadows only, no huge ground shadow. Airy hierarchy readable at 300dp; just two people and a handful of carefully composed contextual objects.
Primary scene: HOTEL BOOKING: a welcoming contemporary boutique hotel with warm ivory curved facade, teal arched entrance and two orange roof accents, two small palms. In the foreground a cheerful adult woman traveler in a lavender blouse and cream trousers holds a smartphone showing a simple check symbol, a friendly hotel concierge in a teal suit offers her a key card. One orange rolling suitcase. Show the interaction clearly, with the complete small hotel as an elegant contextual backdrop. No oversized padlock or bed icon.
